_comment: Mine art sources. Both mines — the overworld Mine and the badlands Company
Mine — were drawn entirely in flat fillRect colours: a brown rectangle for
floor, a darker one for wall, a coloured blob for each ore vein. The Miner's
Cave pack ships a 32x32 master tileset at exactly the game's tile size, so
this maps its cells onto the TL mine enum and drawMineTile draws real art.
The source is one uniform grid, so cells are addressed as [col, row] rather
than cut by connected region the way tools/build_jungle.py has to do it.
`tiles` are single 32x32 cells drawn at the tile's top-left with no anchor —
floors, walls, veins, rails, anything that fills a tile.
`sprites` span several stacked cells and anchor bottom-centre, so the thing
stands on its tile and overhangs upward. A minecart is 32x64.

floor deliberately excludes cell [3,2]: it is the pack's flat untextured
  fill, and mixed one-in-four with the three cobble tiles it read as pale
  mauve patches rather than as floor.
The pack also ships lava pools, water pools, coffins and a dragon trap. None
of those belong in a frontier coal mine, so none of them are mapped.
